// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto. Edit puerto.toml, then run `puerto generate bootstrap`.
use std::sync::Arc;

use business::application::order::create_order::CreateOrderUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::order::delete_order::DeleteOrderUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::order::get_order::GetOrderUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::order::list_orders::ListOrdersUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::order::update_order::UpdateOrderUseCaseImpl;

use business::domain::order::repository::OrderRepositoryTrait;
use infrastructure::order::repository::PgOrderRepository;

use poem::Endpoint;
use poem_openapi::OpenApiService;

use crate::api::order::routes::OrderApi;

/// The routes, wired. An error is what stopped the startup: `main` prints it and exits 1.
pub async fn build_app(config: puerto_web::Config) -> Result<impl Endpoint, String> {
    let database_url = std::env::var("DATABASE_URL").map_err(|_| {
        "DATABASE_URL is not set — set it in .env (.env.example has one)".to_string()
    })?;
    let pool = infrastructure::db::create_postgres_pool(&database_url)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("{e} — is the database up? `make docker-compose/up`"))?;
    infrastructure::db::run_migrations(&pool, &infrastructure::db::MIGRATOR)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let order_repo: Arc<dyn OrderRepositoryTrait> = Arc::new(PgOrderRepository::new(pool.clone()));
    let create_order = Arc::new(CreateOrderUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&order_repo),
    });
    let get_order = Arc::new(GetOrderUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&order_repo),
    });
    let list_orders = Arc::new(ListOrdersUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&order_repo),
    });
    let update_order = Arc::new(UpdateOrderUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&order_repo),
    });
    let delete_order = Arc::new(DeleteOrderUseCaseImpl {
        repository: order_repo,
    });
    let order_api = OrderApi {
        create_order,
        get_order,
        list_orders,
        update_order,
        delete_order,
    };

    let ready = puerto_web::health::probe(move || {
        let pool = pool.clone();
        async move { infrastructure::db::ping(&pool).await }
    });

    // `app.rs` is the project's own: middleware and routes added there wrap everything here.
    Ok(crate::app::configure(puerto_web::routes(
        openapi_service(order_api),
        &config,
        ready,
    )))
}

/// The API service, built in one place: whatever else reads its spec (the export test of a project
/// with `web/`) sees the API the server answers.
fn openapi_service<T: poem_openapi::OpenApi>(api: T) -> OpenApiService<T, ()> {
    OpenApiService::new(api, env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME"), env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))
}
